defects.summary: The documented starter seed (`npm run seed -- --segment mN`, scripts/seed.mjs) crashes on its first write against a clean backend: `TypeError: c.session is not a function` (line 8 calls session() on a snapback4/client online client, which has no such method). Starter content cannot be installed from a clean checkout by the documented path. The M1, M2 and M3 acceptance suites fail from a clean checkout at their seed-idempotency steps (M1 and M2 abort before any other test runs).
defects.evidence: trace.md#p1; grading/evidence/seed-m1.txt, seed-m1-retry.txt, suite-m1.txt, suite-m2.txt, suite-m3.txt; scripts/seed.mjs:8; node_modules/snapback4/dist/client.d.ts (Client has no session())

defects.summary: A DM can be permanently broken. chat.leave is exposed as "Leave conversation" in DM settings, and chat.removeMember has no group check, so the DM creator (stored as admin) can remove the peer. Either way the pair can never talk again: createDm returns the existing dmPairs channel, where the removed/left user gets NOT_MEMBER, and addMember refuses DMs (GROUP_REQUIRED). The remaining party keeps sending into a channel nobody receives. The removal also revokes the peer's server access to shared DM history.
defects.evidence: trace.md#a8 (grading/evidence/dm-membership.json); snapback/chat.q removeMember/leave/createDm; ui ChatSettingsForm renders "Leave conversation" for non-groups

defects.summary: The chat-list unread badge counts the viewer's own messages. ChatRow computes unreadCount = conversation.sequence - readSequence (src/Chats.tsx), so three messages the user sent from another device/API show as "3" unread on this device until the chat is opened.

Opening the "chat" scope from the Search tab (not from a conversation) silently searches the hard-coded fixture conversation d-alice-bob (src/Chats.tsx Search: params.conversationId ?? 'd-alice-bob'). Bob gets unrelated d-alice-bob hits; any user outside that DM (e.g. Carol) always sees "No results".
defects.evidence: trace.md#w3 (bob 5 hits, carol 0 hits + empty state)

defects.summary: The delivered backend runs `snapback4 dev`. That exposes an unauthenticated loopback POST /seed which writes arbitrary rows as the system principal with every rule bypassed (HTTP 200 with no credentials), and it accepts x-snapback-persona dev identities. Any local process can write around the app's authorization. The lane's own M8 suite relies on this route. Loopback-only, so minor, but it is the delivered posture, not `deploy`/`serve`.
defects.evidence: trace.md#a8 (api-checks.json tb-dev-surfaces); package.json backend script; README "This delivered benchmark instance"

defects.summary: Reactions accept arbitrary non-emoji text (`emoji: text 1..64`, no emoji validation; the UI also offers a free-text "Any emoji" field). "not an emoji" was stored and aggregated as a reaction.
defects.evidence: trace.md#a4 (api-checks.json m4-reactions nonEmojiReaction: sent); snapback/chat.q react

defects.summary: The duplicate-handle error shows raw storage-constraint text ("profiles.byHandle already has a row where handle = 'alice'") instead of user-facing copy.
DMs are titled with the generic "Direct message" in the conversation header and as the global-search group label, so different DMs are indistinguishable in grouped search results.
defects.evidence: trace.md#w3 (allGroups ["Direct message","Weekend Plans"]); trace.md#x1 screenshot m5-expiry-offline-relaunch.png

defects.summary: Tapping media on a multi-image post always opens the first image (PostCard passes images[0] to MediaViewer), so later images cannot be viewed full-size.

O1.anchorsCited: Between 60 ("M1-M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap") and 90 ("every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts"), nearer 90 on behavior but held down by missing artifacts and a whole milestone.
O1.justification: 100 of 119 in-scope assertions pass under independent execution. M1-M5 and M8 web behavior is solid; M6 passes every non-native assertion. Not passed: m3-a15 (seed broken from a clean checkout, d-01); all 7 M6 and 2 M8 iOS-simulator native-artifact assertions (no simulator artifact recorded); all 9 M7 assertions (M7 not run, but in the full-run denominator). The 90 anchor needs platform-proof artifacts and every milestone green, neither of which holds.

O2.anchorsCited: Just below 60 ("a few medium defects off the happy path"), above 30 ("multiple high-severity defects in core flows").
O2.justification: Two major defects. d-01: the documented seed crashes on a clean store, breaking clean-checkout acceptance for M1-M3. d-02: a DM "Leave conversation" or creator removal permanently breaks the pair. Four minor defects: d-03 own messages counted unread, d-04 hard-coded search conversation, d-05 unauthenticated dev /seed in the delivered posture, d-06 non-emoji reactions. Three cosmetic: d-07, d-08, d-09. No crashes or data loss in core messaging, feeds, media, expiry or digest flows.

O3.anchorsCited: Between 60 ("core reads protected; a secondary probe succeeds when it shouldn't") and 90 ("every probe correctly denied, including asset access after view-once/delete").
O3.justification: DEVIATION: no holdout probe set was committed for this wave, so this score cannot follow the frozen rule (rotated probes only). It comes from the grader-class trust assertions plus grader authorization checks and is not comparable to probe-based O3. All denied: non-member history/search/settings/send/react/edit/delete/ack/typing/self-add; cross-chat quotes; foreign asset attachment; asset after delete, view-once (410 on every session), expiry and member removal; expired edit/delete windows server-side; logout and refresh token revocation; non-admin rename/color/background/add/remove/promote; digest excludes non-member and departed chats. Held below 90 by d-02 (a DM participant can remove the peer and revoke their server access to shared history) and d-05 (the delivered dev server exposes an unauthenticated rule-bypassing /seed on loopback). trace.md#a1-a8, #x1, #g1.

O4.anchorsCited: Below 30 ("cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app"); nothing approaches 60 ("reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered") or 90 ("... on the native proof, including M8's durable-queue restart and multi-device convergence evidence").
O4.justification: O4 is applicable (M6 web-green) but is scored only from native simulator choreography artifacts, and none exist. Both segment summaries record ios-simulator-m6/m8 pass:null, status not-recorded; artifacts/ holds Hermes bundle exports only; choreography/simulator.md says native scoring "remains null or failed until this artifact exists". Nothing native was demonstrated. The small non-zero score credits honest disclosure: the run record and README state no simulator proof is claimed, and web-only offline evidence is labeled supplemental. trace.md#c2.

O5.bandRationale: First-match order 0,30,60,90,75 over the lane's recorded replay (attempt 2 on a fresh instance; attempt 1 aborted on socket exhaustion and showed Following500/Following5 = 4.08 before the feed architecture changed). 0: not fired. The invariant manifest conforms at 10%, 50% and final (3141/3141 checks each, including the named O5 fixtures), and a grader spot check of a clone of the scale store matched the combined manifest: 1008 profiles, 50228 posts, 100015 messages, 5921 follows, g0001 10000 messages, u0500 500 follows and 100 conversations, u0900 900 followers. The replay wall cap is uncalibrated, so it cannot have been exhausted. 30: not fired. All 10 lane-measured degradation rules pass: max ratio 1.28 search final/10%, following 1.03, celebrity read 1.14, celebrity write 0.95, history p50/p1 0.98, insights and trending flat, both mid-curve rules satisfied. No probe timed out or errored; cold sync of 100 conversations took 1421 ms with flat heap. 60: not fired. No absolute ceilings are calibrated, so none is exceeded, and >80% of an uncalibrated cap cannot be established. 90: not established, because per-probe ceiling utilization and cap fraction are undefined without calibrated ceilings or cap. 75 fires. Caveat: no wave probe set was committed, so inputs are the lane's own k=20 p95 probes (evidence/scale-performance.json, scale-*-probes.json), not grader-run rotated probes (trace.md#o5).

notes: N=1 calibration grading, not claim-eligible; labeled uncalibrated-grader. Deviations: (1) no holdout probe set was committed, so phase 4 was skipped, probeSetSha256 is none-uncommitted, probeResults is empty, and O3 is scored from checklist trust assertions and grader authorization checks, not rotated probes; (2) the Claude family has not passed calibration, so calibrationPassed is false; (3) timing checks are best-of-3 with machine load recorded beside grader timings in trace.md (shared host, load average about 13-22 on 18 cores). The frozen schema permits only m1-m7 IDs, so the 18 M8 results are in grading/m8-assertion-results.json. rerunsUsed=1 is the m6 builder-suite re-run after a grader sequencing artifact (presence lag).
